title: Dense data table
prompt: Design the Orders screen of "Freightline", an operations console for a regional logistics company. Desktop, 1440x900. Operators scan hundreds of rows a day, so density and scannability matter more than decoration. Include: a page header with title "Orders", a count "1,284 orders", and actions "Export CSV" (secondary) and "New order" (primary); a toolbar with search, status filter chips (All, Pending 42, In transit 318, Delayed 17, Delivered 907) with In transit active, a date filter and a column settings button; a table with at least 14 visible rows and columns: checkbox, Order ID (e.g. FL-20931), Customer, Origin -> Destination, Status (badge), Carrier, ETA, Weight (kg), Value (USD); 2 rows selected with a bulk action bar showing "2 selected"; at least one Delayed row; sortable header indicator on ETA; and pagination "1-25 of 318". Light theme.
requiredContent: Export CSV and New order buttons
Search, status chips with counts (In transit active), date filter, column settings
Table >= 14 rows with the 9 specified columns
2 selected rows and a bulk action bar
constraints: Realistic, varied data (no repeated identical rows)

checklist.text: At least 14 table rows are visible within the viewport.
All nine columns are present in the stated order (checkbox through Value).
Numeric columns (Weight, Value) are right-aligned or use tabular figures so digits line up.
Status values are badges with distinct colors per status, and Delayed is the most alarming color.
Exactly two rows are visibly selected (checked) and a bulk bar shows "2 selected".
The In transit chip is active and chip counts match the prompt (42, 318, 17, 907).
ETA header shows a sort indicator.
Pagination reads "1-25 of 318" (dash style may vary).
Row data is varied and realistic: order IDs, customers, routes and values differ row to row.
Row height and cell padding are uniform; column text aligns to consistent left edges.
"New order" is the only primary-styled button.
No cell text overlaps or overflows into neighboring cells; long values are truncated with an ellipsis if needed.
Table text is at least 12px with sufficient contrast.
